_what: Validation thresholds for expansion-card artwork. Edit here, not in code. confirmed:false means the repository never defined the number and a person must confirm it.

main.note: The card's art window is 593x484 (render_generated_card.SLOT_PHOTO); 968px is 2x. The approved ChatGPT cutouts carry alpha ~252 in their body, not 255, so 'opaque' means alpha >= 240.

pixel.note: Native 21-24px per side, PNG, transparent corners. The owner-approved #57-61 icons carry 100+ colours and (#57) soft alpha, which the original heuristics rejected; palette / semi-transparency / gradient checks are now WARNINGS, judge by eye.

tall.note: APPROVED production format (owner handoff for #57-61): the plant filled with the exact 500x500 gradient pixels, as a transparent 390x630 layer aligned to the card-back template. Replaces the unconfirmed 600x900 placeholder.
